race.description: Private Drivers Online Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: MAJESTIC LEGEND (11) opened this prep with a couple of nice placings over this distance at Hawkesbury then had a month off before a midfield finish at Wyong last start. Better for that latest outing and should be at her peak for this. ZINGER (5) raced wide and did a good job to keep coming and finish second on debut last time out over this distance at Wyong. The gate doesn't help but with that race experience now on board she is a real threat. UNION (7) was there to win but just tired in the closing stages first-up over this course and distance recently. Needs a top ride from the wide alley but with added fitness he comes right into calculations. RED HOT ROSIE (1) started at $3.20 but knocked up badly at her only appearance to date back in February 2025 at Canterbury. Big recent trial winner - the market will tell the tale. HARRY'S HUSSEY (10) took out a recent Rosehill trial and looks set for a bright debut.
